tools.description: Search posts already imported into the authenticated user's AgentMash library. Use for requests to find their saved content by topic, author, platform (including newsletters forwarded to their Pro address) or collection. Matches keywords and, when enabled for the account, meaning. Returns snippets and original URLs, with limit and offset pagination. Omit query to list newest imports. Does not search the live web or sync platforms. Read-only; calls count toward account usage and appear in the user's activity log.

collection_id.description: Only saves in this collection (see list_collections).

platform.description: Only saves from this platform (x, linkedin, instagram, reddit, youtube, facebook, web or newsletter).

query.description: What to look for, in plain words. Omit to list saves newest first.

saved_within_days.description: Only saves imported in the last N days.

tools.name: search_saves
tools.title: Search saves

tools.description: Read one saved post in the authenticated user's AgentMash library using an id returned by a saves tool. Returns stored full text, original URL, and available transcript, media, links, stats and collections. Missing content is not fetched from the source platform. An unknown or inaccessible id returns no save. Read-only; calls count toward account usage and appear in the user's activity log.

id.description: The save id from search_saves or recent_saves.

tools.name: get_save
tools.title: Get a save

tools.description: List posts imported into the authenticated user's AgentMash library within the last N days, newest imports first. Use for a recent library recap. Dates reflect import time, which can differ from when the user originally saved a post. Returns up to limit results. Read-only; calls count toward account usage and appear in the user's activity log.

days.description: How many days back to look (1 to 365).

limit.description: Maximum number of saves to return (1 to 50).

tools.name: recent_saves
tools.title: Recent saves

tools.description: Read the authenticated user's AgentMash source status, saved-post counts, last sync times and reconnection status. Includes the newsletters source when forwarding is in use. Use to check which imported sources are available. Does not connect, reconnect or sync any platform. Read-only; calls count toward account usage and appear in the user's activity log.
tools.name: list_sources
tools.title: List sources

tools.description: List the authenticated user's AgentMash collections with ids, names, sources and saved-post counts. Use to find a collection to browse. Includes imported folders and lists when available. Empty collections are omitted unless include_empty is true. Does not create or change collections. Read-only; calls count toward account usage and appear in the user's activity log.

include_empty.description: Also list collections that have no saves.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.title: List collections

tools.description: List saved posts from one collection in the authenticated user's AgentMash library, newest imports first, using a collection_id from list_collections. Supports limit and offset pagination. An empty collection returns no saves; an unknown or inaccessible collection returns an error. Read-only; calls count toward account usage and appear in the user's activity log.

limit.description: Maximum number of saves to return (1 to 50).

offset.description: How many saves to skip, for paging.

tools.name: get_collection_saves
tools.title: Get collection saves
